On 22 September 2026, a Google AI Overviews answer described Dentrix Ascend as “Cloud-hosted version of classic Dentrix workflows.” Our [Wrong About You review](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23270124) marked that description wrong against the vendor page read on 8 October 2026. An official company-information page should make the product boundary explicit and link its support. This remains a historical statement review in progress, not a current product test.
